title: Generic live product path expansion wave 1
goal: Promote the full first batch of exact live shapes onto the generic live product path without splitting the work: static HTTP servers (node static server, Go static HTTP binary, Rust static HTTP binary, BusyBox httpd), listener tools (BusyBox nc listener, socat file responder, Unix pathname listener shapes), file-backed workers (cat/readonly cursor, grep/readonly cursor, tail append-log shape, reader/readonly cursor workers), and additional narrow service exact-shape coverage where safe. Every promotion must require exact live-capture observed graph matching, explicit migration.productPath exact-live-capture metadata, support proof evidence, equivalent refusal proof evidence, and refusalClasses=[]. Hard shapes such as active clients, writable service data, service-managed children, Redis persistence/non-empty data, rsync writable/auth, and PHP live fd/runtime state must stay refused or be modeled one-at-a-time with target-native proof. No arbitrary process restore, broad daemon/service/database migration, source-ISA emulation, interactive terminal migration, or metadata-only success may be claimed.
